WholeTimedProcess.Source: Darwin /usr/bin/time -l whole-child measurement; RSS unit bytes; includes imported-package initialization, preflight, original API/wrapper work and checkpoint I/O; excludes parent controller. Missing or ambiguous fields are null.

Limits: Exactly one child attempt, no automatic retry; 60s triggers process-group SIGKILL then Wait. Exact controller elapsed bound is not guaranteed after kill/Wait.
GOMAXPROCS1 and 256MiB Go soft heap limit are settings, not total RSS hard limits. OS fields may be unobserved/null; raw stdout/stderr paths are private.
Saved dispatch count is durable intent, not proof of a returned in-flight API. Partial prefix never fills missing outcomes or labels.
Controller author-side pure checks are separate from independent observer source/Want review. Source/binary pins and compiler metadata are provenance, not formal trusted-compiler proof.

24 finite probes cover two proposed behavior goals; completion with differences remains an observation, distinct from all24 Wants matched and training/parent-label/caption/generalization qualification.
